I have created **TaskFlow**, a modern, responsive to-do and productivity web application.

You can view the live site here:
👉 **[Open TaskFlow](https://antigravity.luch.dev/site/bb47114f-9e38-4199-8a9c-bc706d51a063/24fa6ceaff44f3d64178f89f/)**

---

### Features Built

- **Smart Organization & Views**:
  - Filter tasks by **All Tasks**, **Today**, **Upcoming**, **High Priority**, and **Completed**.
  - Categorize by project tags (Work, Personal, Shopping, Ideas, Health) or create your own custom categories with colored badges.
- **Task Management**:
  - Quick-add bar with inline priority, due date, category selectors, and notes.
  - Subtasks / checklists support with progress tracking.
  - Sorting (by Due Date, Priority, Creation Date, Alphabetical) and real-time search with `Ctrl + K` or `/`.
  - Bulk actions: Mark all complete, clear completed, and reset demo data.
- **Interactive Experience & Delight**:
  - Full **Dark Mode / Light Mode** support.
  - Built-in Web Audio synthesizer for tactile sound feedback (toggleable in header).
  - Celebratory confetti effects upon completing tasks.
  - Undo notifications when deleting tasks.
  - JSON backup/restore and Markdown task export.
  - Keyboard shortcuts (`N` for new task, `Esc` to close modals, `?` for cheat sheet).

### Project Files
- [index.html](file:///home/agent/workspace/index.html) — Application structure, modals, and responsive layout.
- [css/styles.css](file:///home/agent/workspace/css/styles.css) — Custom typography, animations, and transitions.
- [js/app.js](file:///home/agent/workspace/js/app.js) — LocalStorage persistence, Web Audio sound effects, subtask management, and state logic.
